scoring_text: delivered summary only; preserve raw output and raw/delivered hashes separately
selector_policy: If over cap, retain the longest complete sentence prefix within the cap; if no complete first sentence fits, cut at word boundary and flag forced_word_boundary=true; append no content
aggregate_reporting: per pipeline/stage attempted/completed denominators, actual length quantiles, capped count/rate and forced-boundary count/rate; no rate inferred from reference proxies
proxy_limit: Eligible train abstract token lengths do not guarantee generated output length or measured feasibility
amendment_rule: Version on development before selection; rebind all dependent scorer/profile/protocol identities. No implicit cap reduction to rescue individual outputs
